description: Source code for the 'restful' package, defining the Response struct and associated methods for handling HTTP responses, including content negotiation, error handling, and response writing.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A wrapper around http.ResponseWriter providing convenience methods for response handling, content negotiation, error handling, and response writing.

methods.name: NewResponse
methods.description: Creates a new Response object wrapping an http.ResponseWriter.

methods.name: DefaultResponseContentType
methods.description: Sets the default response content type (e.g., JSON or XML).

methods.name: InternalServerError
methods.description: Writes a 500 Internal Server Error status.

methods.name: Hijack
methods.description: Implements http.Hijacker interface to hijack the connection if supported.

methods.name: PrettyPrint
methods.description: Sets whether the response should produce pretty (indented) XML/JSON.

methods.name: AddHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the response.

methods.name: SetRequestAccepts
methods.description: Sets the MIME type(s) the request accepts.

methods.name: EntityWriter
methods.description: Returns an EntityReaderWriter suitable for the request's Accept header.

methods.name: WriteEntity
methods.description: Writes an entity with status 200 OK.

methods.name: WriteHeaderAndEntity
methods.description: Writes a response with specified status and entity, handling content negotiation.

methods.name: WriteAsXml
methods.description: Writes a value as XML.

methods.name: WriteHeaderAndXml
methods.description: Writes a status and value as XML.

methods.name: WriteAsJson
methods.description: Writes a value as JSON.

methods.name: WriteJson
methods.description: Writes a value as JSON with specified content type.

methods.name: WriteHeaderAndJson
methods.description: Writes a status and value as JSON with specified content type.

methods.name: WriteError
methods.description: Writes an error response with specified HTTP status.

methods.name: WriteServiceError
methods.description: Writes a ServiceError as response.

methods.name: WriteErrorString
methods.description: Writes an error message as response.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to the client.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Overrides to record the status code.

methods.name: StatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code that was written.

methods.name: ContentLength
methods.description: Returns the total bytes written.

methods.name: CloseNotify
methods.description: Returns a channel that receives a notification when the connection is closed.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error set by WriteError.
